To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the inclusion complexation of menthol with cyclodextrins enhanced its water-solubilization and thermal stability, and the menthol/ cyclodextrin inclusion complexes were electrospun to form menthol/CD inclusion complex nanofiber webs without using additional polymer.

the electrospinning of highly concentrated aqueous menthol/CD-inclusion complex solutions (160%, wt/wt) produced bead-free menthol/CD inclusion complex nanofiber (IC NF) webs with high water-solubilizing and slow-release character of menthol and high-temperature (up to 250 °C) stability of menthol.
menthol/CDs inclusion complex was formed and electrospinning of menthol/IC NFs was successfully performed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the formation of stable menthol/CDs-IC and the electrospinning of menthol/IC-CD NFs for the first time.
the formation of menthol/cyclomatrix inclusion complex (menthol/cyclodextin-inclusion complex) and its application in electrospun nanofibers.
the formation of menthol/HPβCD and menthol/HPγCD inclusion complex and their application in the production of self-standing and high-temperature stable menthol/CD-inclusion-complex nanofibrous web.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the menthol/β-CD-IC and menthol/γ-CD-IC NF mats have shown high water-solubilization and thermal stability of menthol due to the inclusion complex formation with CDs.
the inclusion complexation of menthol and CDs enhanced the water-solvency and high-temperature (thermal) stability of menthol, which was further improved by electrospinning into menthol/CDs-IC NFs.
menthol/CDs-inclusion complex nanofibrous materials can be used as an efficient delivery system for menthol in various applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
menthol/CD-inclusion complexation and electrospinning of menthol/IC NFs are promising methods to enhance the water-soluble and high-temperature stable menthol for various applications.
inclusion complexation between menthol and CDs (HPβ- and HPγ-CD) in aqueous solution and electrospinning of menthol/HPβ- or HPγ-CD-IC NF webs from these aqueous solutions were successfully performed.

the menthol/HPβCD-IC and menthol/HPγCD-IC NF webs can be used in various applications such as slow-release of mentholic fragrance and flavor, antibacterial and antifungal applications, and as a slow-release carrier of menthol in pharmaceutical applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that

electrospinning of menthol/HPβCD-IC and menthol/HPγCD-IC NF webs can be used for the controlled release of menthol and the menthol/HPCD-IC NF web can be used as a self-standing, flexible, fast-dissolving, and high-temperature stable menthol delivery system.
the menthol/β- or γ-CD-IC NF webs are suitable for various applications like food and cosmetic products, and also as antibacterial agent in medical applications.
electrospun menthol/CD inclusion complex NFs have shown enhanced water-solubilization and thermal stability of menthol which may be useful for food, pharmacy, and cosmetic applications.
